what_i_changed: Updated `gitseed/category.py` to use a private manifest-entry parser. Exact normalized `mcp` produces `manifest_entries: mcp`; exact `ollama` produces `dependencies: ollama`. Prose, comments, metadata, and longer names no longer trigger either signal.
how_it_takes_the_required_approach: Implemented as a separate parser component within the existing category module, replacing raw text scanning while preserving the evidence basis and category-pack behavior.
